outcome_definition: Price European call options with Monte Carlo, compare against analytic Black–Scholes; measure streamed Total time (ms.) at fixed representative scale.

source_licences.permissions: Use, modification and redistribution allowed with notice/disclaimer retention and no endorsement without permission.
source_licences.cuda_dependency_terms: Source licence links CUDA EULA; toolkit terms apply.
source_licences.verification: Licence fetched independently; benchmark implementation excerpts available in brief.

stock_CUDA_image.feasibility: Provisionally compatible with documented target Ubuntu 22.04, CUDA Toolkit 12.8 and driver 570 with patch >=570.26; actual stock image, GPU and development tools unverified.
stock_CUDA_image.unavailable_reason: No reproduction performed; exact installed toolkit, driver patch, GPU and CMake unknown. Brief notes inconsistent README toolkit versions.

size.data_GiB_scope: External dataset download size only; generated arrays belong to working set.
size.reason: No published peak memory bound for fixed 1048576-option workload; do not infer total footprint from external download size.

scoring.timing: Report streamed Total time (ms.) for fixed representative workload.
scoring.accuracy: Check anchors.json on published 8192-option case; retain exit status.
scoring.reserve: Sum Confidence / abs(MC-BS) only when error > 1e-6; divide by full option count. Confidence is discounted 1.96-standard-error width.
scoring.L1: sum(abs(BS-MC))/sum(abs(BS)); record only, no published numeric acceptance target.
scoring.rounding: Strict reserve > 1; at six-decimal printed boundary use verdict or recompute unrounded statistic.

rules: Record GPU model, visible GPU count, grid size, toolkit, driver and libc.
Fix one visible GPU; default float precision; preserve path count.

seeds.gpu: Block/device/thread-derived cuRAND initialization; GPU geometry affects streams.

repeatability.reason: No published repetition count or timing tolerance supplied.

anchor_independence: Both criteria are upstream NVIDIA published acceptance criteria, independent of this intake; they express same predicate, not two independent measurements.

source_verification.licence: Fetched from pinned raw GitHub source via web.
source_verification.implementation: Web fetches unavailable (cache miss); shell network fallback blocked by allowlist. Anchor/configuration evidence retained from supplied brief with pinned citations.
